study_system.scientific_role: fresh EOG-specific independent validation candidate for the post-Glanville two-layer predictor

known_from_publication: the system is a long-term spatially structured pond population
published models analyse patch colonization, persistence and growth using neighboring-patch covariates with a distance-decay function
published aggregate ecological findings and turnover patterns were viewed during candidate screening
independence_boundary.rule: Published ecological findings may justify comparator class and process relevance but must not tune EOG worlds, structural thresholds, Layer-B features, holdout years or favourable/adverse rules.
independence_boundary.label: fresh EOG-specific independent validation; not completely outcome-naive ecological-system validation

source.source_freeze_rule: enumerate all Zenodo files from record metadata, download and checksum published files without parsing response rows, and preserve only metadata/code/documentation/response-free geometry in Gate 0 artifacts

public_process_basis.landscape: more than 350 human-managed freshwater ponds in the Forez plain
public_process_basis.ever_occupied_reported: 95 ponds were occupied at least once between 1976 and 2019
public_process_basis.annual_monitoring: occupied colonies and drained ponds were identified annually during the breeding season from 1976 to 2019
public_process_basis.drained_pond_semantics: drained ponds are unavailable habitat for that breeding season and must not be treated as ordinary available negative ponds
public_process_basis.process_match: patch colonization/persistence is explicitly modelled as a spatially structured population process with distance-dependent neighboring-patch effects
public_process_basis.process_closure_boundary: The EOG claim is conditional on the declared Forez pond universe and current occupied source ponds; no unique dispersal history or complete closure to all immigration outside the study region is claimed.

node_universe_gate.critical_question: Does the archived geometry include the prospectively surveyed pond universe independently of future occupancy outcomes, or only the 95 ponds that were ever occupied?
pass_if: pond IDs and geometry/distance are available without reading occupancy response rows
the candidate node universe is defined by survey/habitat availability rather than by ever having a colony
unoccupied-but-surveyed available ponds can be represented without future-response selection
stop_if: the only machine-readable pond universe consists of ponds selected because they were occupied at least once during 1976-2019
node inclusion requires inspecting future colony occurrence
pond identity/geometry cannot be frozen independently of response
node_universe_gate.reason: Selecting only ever-occupied ponds would condition the prediction universe on future response and invalidate a fresh colonization/non-colonization benchmark.

response_semantics_gate.target_candidate: annual survey-recorded colonization of an available pond that was unoccupied at t and is available at t+1
response_semantics_gate.positive_candidate: available pond with a colony recorded at t+1
response_semantics_gate.negative_candidate: available and surveyed pond with no colony recorded at t+1
response_semantics_gate.unavailable_state: drained pond-year; exclude from ordinary binary colonization target rather than code as negative
response_semantics_gate.forbidden_negative: missing/not-surveyed/unrepresented pond-year must never be recoded as absence
response_semantics_gate.pass_requirement: archive schema/code must mechanically distinguish available-unoccupied, occupied and drained/unavailable states before any response data values are inspected
response_semantics_gate.stop_requirement: if absence/survey availability is implicit only through missing rows or only ever-occupied ponds are recorded, stop rather than invent binary negatives

allowed_at_gate0: Zenodo record metadata, filenames, sizes and checksums
file bytes solely for exact checksum verification
full files that are unambiguously response-free geometry/distance metadata by filename plus code/documentation contract
bounded first physical record/header of text-like data files using eog.v2.validation.read_bounded_first_record_text
forbidden_at_gate0: deserializing binary response objects to inspect values
using published aggregate response results to tune EOG design

two_layer_architecture_freeze.latent_layer: exact frozen rule identities retained for compatibility, current-source propagation, contraction and finite-universe falsification

structural_gate_if_gate0_passes.distance_basis: freeze archive-provided pond coordinates or explicit pond distance matrix; no response-derived geometry
requirements: at least three distinct positive structural thresholds
structural_gate_if_gate0_passes.no_rescue: do not add kNN/arbitrary thresholds after observing a scale-diversity failure

external_comparator_class.primary: published-style patch occupancy/colonization model using focal and neighboring patch covariates with distance-decay influence
external_comparator_class.flexible: predeclared flexible classifier using the same response-free pond/source geometry and non-response availability covariates
external_comparator_class.freeze_later: exact comparator features/hyperparameters and holdout years only after Gate 0/structural gates pass and before response rows

pass_if_all: Zenodo record and all required source bytes are reproducibly frozen
response-bearing data can be separated from code/documentation/geometry
pond node universe is not future-response-selected
pond coordinates or explicit distances are response-free and deterministic
occupied / available-unoccupied / drained-unavailable states are mechanically representable without inventing absence
a sufficiently long temporal sequence exists for prospective calibration/heldout design
conditional internal-source patch propagation remains scientifically defensible
stop_if_any: source bytes cannot be reproducibly frozen
only ever-occupied ponds define the node universe
surveyed absence cannot be separated from missing/not-surveyed
process/source semantics are incompatible with an internal-source conditional forecast

post_gate0_sequence: freeze canonical pond universe and response-free geometry
freeze temporal source/update semantics and pond availability treatment
freeze published-style occupancy/neighborhood comparator and flexible external comparator
freeze temporal calibration/heldout split from metadata only
only then open response rows once
no_rescue_rule: If Gate 0 or structural adequacy fails, stop pre-response and move to another fresh candidate.
